title: Connector heartbeat
description: Connector to hub every interval_ms (C-07.34, C-07.35). The per-chat fields come from the connector's supervision (06), GET /api/health (web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/server/routes/health.js: boot, viewers) and GET /api/queue/policy (lib/server/routes/queue.js:191: channel_connected). No pid crosses (C-07.36).

machine_id.description: The machine's hub id. Contract 03 fixes the grammar; this pattern is the widest it may take.

beat.description: Counter per link connection, from 1. A lower value means a new connection.

interval_ms.description: The interval the connector is beating at, as the hub set it at attach in hello.ack heartbeat_ms: 15000 in protocol 1 (C-05.17, C-07.34), so stale after 37.5 s and offline after 60 s.

connector_now.description: Connector wall clock when sent. Used only to estimate skew_ms (C-07.33).

echo_at.description: The at of the last hub ping the connector received, echoed so the hub can time the round trip.

chats.description: One row per chat the connector supervises on this machine.

chat_id.description: The chat label (contract 03 section 2): the chat id without its `cht_` prefix, as every 05 frame names a chat on the link. The hub maps it to the chat id it records.

daemon.description: The daemon's state as the connector's supervision sees it (06): one of C-07.5's chat.daemon states.

oneOf.description: A daemon's per-boot token, read from the X-WC-Boot response header where the daemon sends it (C-07.9, Q-07.1), else from GET /api/health (web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/server/routes/health.js:131). Today `${pid}:${Date.now()}` from lib/server/index.js:156; from alpha.4 random per createServer and without the pid (C-07.15, Q-07.8). Opaque to the hub: compared for equality only, never parsed (C-07.36).

boot.description: The running daemon's boot, null when not running.

viewers.description: Connected sockets per GET /api/health viewers (relayed chrome included).

ring_seq.description: The highest ring position the connector has read for this boot (C-07.12, C-07.35).

channel_connected.description: Whether a Push would wake Claude now (queue policy channel_connected).
